PHASE 3 VERIFICATION ARTIFACT — STATUS: UNSATISFIED
====================================================

This file is the gate artifact promised by
plans/260523-1813-zalo-personal-quoted-messages/phase-03-extend-sendmessage-for-quote-endpoint.md.

The phase plan REQUIRES one of:
  (A) A captured HTTP request from a real zca-js session sending a quoted
      message, with the exact URL + decrypted form body recorded here.
  (B) A live smoke test confirming the implementation against a real Zalo
      Personal account renders a native quote bubble.

Neither has been collected yet. The implementation is shipping with the
following INFERRED values pending verification:

URL path suffix (DM):    /api/message/quote
URL path suffix (group): /api/group/quote
Encrypted payload fields (in addition to the existing send fields):
  qmsgOwner   = TQuote.OwnerID
  qmsgId      = TQuote.GlobalMsgID (string form)
  qmsgCliId   = TQuote.CliMsgID    (string form)
  qmsgType    = classifyQuoteMsgType(TQuote.CliMsgType)
  qmsg        = TQuote.Msg
  qmsgAttach  = TQuote.Attach (opaque JSON string, verbatim)
  qmsgTs      = TQuote.TS    (string form)
  qmsgTtl     = TQuote.TTL   (int)

Reasoning recorded in internal/channels/zalo/personal/protocol/send.go:
the /quote path REPLACES the /sms (or /sendmsg) suffix per zca-js
sendMessage.ts:290-302 (`pathname + "/quote"` is the alternative branch to
`pathname + "/sms"`). The original plan documented appending /quote after
/sms; that turned out to be wrong on re-read.

Failure mode if any of the above is incorrect:
  - Phase 4's sendChunkWithQuoteFallback retries without the quote on any
    non-zero error_code, so a wrong URL or wrong field name surfaces as
    "quotes silently downgrade to plain replies" rather than message loss.
  - The fallback warn log "zalo_personal.quote.fallback_no_quote" is the
    canary; if it fires on every quoted reply in dev, the URL or field names
    are wrong.

REQUIRED before merge:
  Capture a real /quote request via Charles / mitmproxy / browser devtools
  with zca-js v2.1.2 in dev, and overwrite this file with:
    - The exact URL (path + query)
    - The decrypted form body (JSON dump of the qmsg* fields actually sent)
    - The exact `error_code` returned by Zalo when quoting a deleted message
      (so nonQuoteErrorCodes in send.go can stay narrowly scoped to auth /
      rate-limit families)
